svg.title: How the pager works
svg.desc: GitHub sends the events of the GitHub App to the Worker on Cloudflare, signed with the secret of its webhook. The rules decide what needs the maintainer; everything else ends there. What counts becomes one message in Telegram, edited in place as it changes, with buttons. A button runs an action of the allowlist on GitHub, such as merging a green release. Drafts, fixes and free text go to the workflow of the private control repository, which runs Claude Code with the maintainer's subscription and sends its answer back, signed, as a draft, a note or a proposal that a button has to approve.
